purpose: Per-quarter FreeNIC refresh ledger. One entry per FFIEC reporting quarter. Each stage is one of: pending | done | na | undocumented, with an ISO ts and a notes string. This file is the machine-readable companion to pipeline/REFRESH.md, so a refresh that spans several sittings can be resumed from a known state.
lag_rule: A quarter (period-end YYYY-06-30 etc.) publishes ~75 days after quarter-end. Y-9C/BHCF (bhcf_filings) and some FDIC products trail the Call/UBPR/SDI core by ~1 quarter; acquire whatever is published, record the trailing product as 'pending', and pick it up next run.
reconstruction_tables_rule: The reconstruction tables luck_equivalent_panel / luck_core_panel / clean_bank_panel_clv_derived REBUILD after each quarterly refresh via pipeline/scripts/50_reconstruct_luck.py --rebuild (MODC re-derives from the refreshed call_report_filings; MODL is input-static) and pipeline/scripts/51_reconstruct_finhist.py (input-static; --rebuild only if the CLV .dta updates), then gate with pipeline/scripts/52_validate_reconstruction.py. Run AFTER ingest+validate, alongside views_regen.

2026Q1.backfill_note: Reconstructed from the build records of the 2026-06-01 warehouse build, which predates this ledger. The 2026Q1 data was loaded on 2026-06-01, before the refresh protocol was written (2026-06-12), so these entries are a retrospective attribution rather than the record of a protocol-driven run.

acquire.notes: Run 07d/07g (in pipeline/scripts/) with the 8-digit argument 20260630. Fixed 2026-07-16: 07d's QENDS was a hardcoded range(2012,2026) and silently did nothing for 2026 and later; both 07d and 07g now self-extend to (current year + 2, floor 2035) and validate their arguments via parse_targets() -- a malformed token or an out-of-range year now errors instead of fetching nothing. A bare year argument works too, but the 8-digit form remains the convention. Q2 publishes ~2026-09-13. FR Y-9C/BHCF will likely still be trailing at 2026Q1.
